articles.title: Venus Williams Lands US Open Wildcard — Will Serena Join the Party?
articles.summary: Venus Williams, 46, got a US Open singles wildcard. Could sister Serena join her? One spot remains, and fans are buzzing.

articles.title: The Battle Over AI Music: Who Gets Paid When Machines Learn to Sing?
articles.summary: AI can now make songs in seconds, but who gets paid? Musicians are fighting for consent and fair pay. It's a huge battle.

articles.title: AI Designs Chip Components 500 Times Smaller — 'Beyond Human Intuition'
articles.summary: AI designed chip parts 500 times smaller than before, some as small as a bacterium. This could revolutionize computing.
